answer: The quartz record keeps the spread, plume schedules the escalation, and atlas publishes the outcome. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 4 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors as a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. A 237 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
